adaptations.kv_shard_check_e2e.py: --parts 3 records three owner decodes; ownership and idle require all three parts; mixed samples require every reported owner live.
adaptations.spill_check.py: Require exact per-rank counter and directory sets for commits, pictures, floor, recovery and cleanup; strict streaming token hashes and terminal completion; rank2 fault target.
adaptations.checklib.py: Explicit credentials and origin-scoped redirects; stream completion validation; descriptor-relative no-follow filesystem operations require matching isolated test-store marker and reject absolute paths, traversal, symlinks and hardlinks.
adaptations.exact.py: Reuse checklib explicit API_KEY/--api-key-file selection, origin-scoped opener and redacted errors/logs/receipts; no implicit credential files.
adaptations.client.py: Remove import-time credential reads/global opener; authenticate only the configured origin via checklib.
